name: Move the engine API under lantern:::
body:
Input:::, World:::, Audio:::, Engine:::, Overlay:::, GameUi:::, Screen:::, Renderer:::, Camera:::, Physics:::, Meshes:::, Textures:::, EngineDebug:::, Angle::: and the host types (Vec3, RayHit, CharacterController, ...) move to lowercase namespaces under lantern::: (lantern:::input:::IsDown, lantern:::math:::Vec3).

Blocked on the Nyx board's GAME-F05-T01 (host functions and types under a namespace): Nyx refuses a namespaced host function and can't see members of a namespaced host type.

comments.text: Waiting on Dean: implement the Nyx side now, or keep the current engine names for the moment.

Done after Dean chose 'Yes, do it now'. Tests pass and the game runs (screenshot in the thread). Vectors are built from braces where the type is known, because Nyx can't put the path before braces yet (GAME-F05-T02).

plan:
- Nyx: namespaced host functions and types (nyx PR #19, GAME-F05-T01).
- api/mod.rs: HostNamespace registers each group's calls as functions under lantern::<group>.
- Types: lantern::math::Vec3/Vec2, lantern::physics::RayHit/ControllerStep/CharacterController.
- Rename every call in games/platformer, the game-host tests and docs; regenerate the host surface; D-045.
- Pin chaos-ui's Nyx to the nyx branch commit; bump to the merge commit once nyx #19 merges.

Folded through 2026-10-30T05:00:00.
